basis: Alice runs her whole blocking_map line inside the group: run_start (X 2.65 / Z -13.42) -> mid_field (2.65 / -4.47) at t=4.2 -> spoil_fan (1.06 / 3.58), slowing to a walk from t=8.6 and standing still from t=10.5 so the arrival reads as an arrival and not a constant-speed glide. That is 17.2 m in 12 s; camera.json sh010 quotes 'thirteen metres in five seconds', but the map only offers 8.94 m between run_start and mid_field, so the map wins and her run sits at about 2.1 m/s, a real child's pace. CRE-001 starts on his own map anchor at mid_field a few bounds ahead of her, bounds and freezes twice (the 'drops out of sight and reappears further off' beat), crosses the pale spoil and goes head-first into the burrow at sh012 t=2.4 (group t=10.4), after which he is hidden. Their lines stay at least 0.75 m apart throughout.
warnings: sh010 is the abeam travelling shot: the rig runs parallel to her line 3.03 m off her -X flank at her own 2.1 m/s, screen-right opens toward +Z (the direction of travel and the rabbit ahead of her), and she holds a constant screen-left position - a translation only, no pan, no reframe.

sh011: the lens sits in the dry ditch 2.3 m beyond the burrow (Z 5.0, clear of the hedge bank at Z 5.36). That is the furthest a camera can stand back on the tile-2 axis without being inside the hedge, so she grows from about 0.17 to about 0.64 of frame height instead of composition's 0.30 to 0.75.

sh012: on the tile-3 axis (mid_field toward spoil_fan) screen-right is -X, and the modelled geometry puts Alice at larger X than the burrow, so her near-foreground shoulder falls on screen-LEFT of the rabbit, not the screen-right third that composition sh012 states. Geometry followed; the screen-side wording belongs to 07-directing/composition.

issues.question: sh010 is an abeam tracking shot (camera.json: 'abeam, travelling with her'), but the blocking_map puts CRE-001's start at mid_field, 8.94 m ahead of her run_start. A 40 mm frame 3.0 m off her flank is 3.2 m wide, so the rabbit composition wants 'in the open two thirds of frame' falls far outside it. Which gives - the abeam rig, or the 8.94 m gap?
issues.provisional: Keep the abeam rig camera.json specifies and let the rabbit stay out of frame in sh010; he is in frame from sh011 onward, where the camera looks down the travel axis.

options.label: Keep the abeam rig; the rabbit is out of frame in sh010 (the default)
options.consequence: sh010 shows only Alice running with empty grass ahead; the white flicker composition asks for has to come from the plate, not the whitebox.

options.label: Bring the rabbit back to a few bounds ahead of her (about 3 m) for sh010
options.consequence: Both fit the abeam frame and the shot works as written, but it moves CRE-001 off his blocking_map start anchor.

options.label: Swing the rig to a forward three-quarter so it sees down the field
options.consequence: The rabbit comes into frame but Alice is pushed to the frame edge and the shot is no longer the abeam travelling shot camera.json specifies.
